fact: The revised procurement strategy (table revised 18.3.2024) lists subcomponent 3.2, development of a national social registry (US$2 million), with recruitment of a firm to develop the Registre Social Unique by quality-and-cost selection and a consultant for its legal institutionalisation.
title: Actualisation de la Stratégie de Passation de Marchés (PPSD, Merankabandi II P175327)
